metadata.title: EEG dataset of unilateral and bilateral movement executions
metadata.description:
This dataset includes EEG data from 8 subjects who were performing self-intended unilateral and bilateral movement executions. 

The dataset is structured as follows. The EEG_dataset folder contains an EEG and Metadata folder. The Metadata folder contains text files for each of the measured subjects identified by an individual pseudo-code with general meta information. Also, a short description of the experiment is provided in an additional text file. The EEG folder contains the EEG measurements separated into the unilateral and bilateral conditions of the study as well as a readme (text file) including useful information about the data recording. In each subfolder of the measurement conditions (unilateral and bilateral) the measurements are stored for each of the subjects. The data is stored in the BrainVision format (see https://www.brainproducts.com/support-resources/brainvision-core-data-format-1-0/ for more information regarding the data format). 

This dataset is part of the publication: "Avoidance of specific calibration sessions in motor intention recognition for exoskeleton-supported rehabilitation through transfer learning on EEG data".
